newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady in narrow trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady in narrow trade.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Friday held steady in a narrow trading range on the local market, dealers said.
Consumer buying was at a low ebb but limited arrivals kept the market around previous levels.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,290/1,315 rupees per quintal. M-30 was steady at 1,320/1,385 rupees.
"Sugar mill delivery remained unquoted as most of the delivery tenders out of the free sale quota for the first half of this month are over," one broker said.
"On this backdrop fresh arrivals in the Bombay market remained low today but will improve next week," he said.
The free sale quota this month is 700,000 tonnes and in April it is the same. Traders said the April quota was lower than the expected 750,000 tonnes.
